idea-plugin.name: Prisma Graph Visualizer
idea-plugin.description:
A plugin for graphical visualization of Prisma Schema files.

Features:

  • Automatic detection of Prisma Schema files (.prisma)
  • Graphical visualization of data models and relationships
  • Live updates when files change
  • Support for multiple schema files
  • Interactive visualization with zoom and pan
  • Dedicated tool window for graph visualization
  • Support for One-to-One, One-to-Many, and Many-to-Many relationships

Supported IDEs:

  • IntelliJ IDEA
  • WebStorm
  • PHPStorm
  • PyCharm
  • GoLand
  • RubyMine
  • CLion
  • DataGrip
  • Rider
  • Android Studio

How to Use:

  1. Open a project containing .prisma files
  2. Open the "Prisma Graph" tool window (View → Tool Windows → Prisma Graph)
  3. The graph will automatically display your schema structure
  4. Use mouse interactions to navigate and explore your data model
